nodes.description: Immutable owner address set once in the constructor; gates houseJoinGame, houseReveal and destruct, and receives house fees.
mapping(uint176 => uint232) storing packed game records (status + player2); written and deleted across the game lifecycle.
mapping(uint176 => bytes32) storing committed hashes for player1 (id+1), player2 (id+2) and house (id+3).
mapping(uint176 => uint) storing revealed numbers used to derive the final randomness.
Caller-controlled address used both as player identity and as the authorization subject in owner checks.
Initializes the immutable OWNER_ADDRESS from msg.sender.
Payable entry point creating a game; validates wager granularity and packs the game id.
Payable entry point letting a second player join an open game and commit their hash.
Owner-only submission of the house hash, moving game status to 3.
Player reveals N; verifies it against their committed hash and records the verified number.
Owner reveals the house number, derives randomness, deletes state and pays out wager plus fee.
Packs player1 address (low 160 bits) and wager (upper bits) into a uint176 game id.
Unpacks player1 address and wager from the encoded game id.
Packs status (low 16 bits) and player2 address into a uint232.
Unpacks status and player2 address from packed game data.
Public view that assembles the GameData struct and reverts if the game does not exist.
Commitment helper computing keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, N)).
Player-cancellable refund path that deletes state and charges a 0.01 ether fee to the owner.
Owner-only function that selfdestructs the contract and sends the balance to the owner.
selfdestruct(payable(OWNER_ADDRESS)) irreversibly destroys the contract and forwards its balance.
payable(g.p1).transfer(payout) in houseReveal sends ETH to a caller-controlled winner address.
payable(OWNER_ADDRESS).transfer(fee) in houseReveal sends the house fee.
payable(OWNER_ADDRESS).transfer(0.01 ether) inside cancelGame charges the cancellation fee.
payable(g.p1).transfer(...) inside cancelGame refunds player1 (minus fee when p1 cancels).
payable(g.p2).transfer(...) inside cancelGame refunds player2 (minus fee when p2 cancels).
payable(g.p1).transfer(g.wager) inside cancelGame refunds the sole player when status == 1.
id |= uint176(wager / 1e17) << 160 performs an unchecked left shift that silently truncates oversized wagers, allowing game id collisions.
bytes32 commitment hash supplied by player1 at game creation.
uint176 game identifier supplied by the joining player.
bytes32 commitment hash supplied by player2.
uint176 game identifier for the house join step.
bytes32 commitment hash supplied by the house.
uint176 game identifier passed to reveal.
uint number revealed by a player and checked against their commitment.
uint176 game identifier passed to houseReveal.
uint house number used as the final randomness seed component.
address packed into the low 160 bits of the game id.
uint wager divided by 1e17 and shifted into the upper bits of the game id.
uint176 packed id decoded back into player1 and wager.
uint16 game status stored in the low bits of the packed word.
address of player2 packed above the status field.
uint232 packed word decoded into status and player2.
uint176 game identifier whose data is assembled.
bool flag controlling whether player hashes are also returned.
uint nonce combined with msg.sender to recompute a commitment hash.
uint176 identifier of the game being cancelled.
Return variable holding the packed game id computed by encodeGameID.
Memory GameData snapshot loaded by getGameData in joinGame.
Memory GameData snapshot loaded in houseJoinGame.
Memory GameData snapshot loaded in reveal.
Memory GameData snapshot loaded in houseReveal before payouts.
Stored house hash read from playerHashes[id+3] before verification.
Recomputed hash from getHash(N) compared with providedHash.
Randomness value derived from the three verified numbers modulo 10000000.
uint payout = wager * 2, then reduced by the house fee.
uint fee = payout * 3 / 100 paid to the owner.
Stored player commitment read from playerHashes[id+1] or playerHashes[id+2].
Hash recomputed from msg.sender and N and compared with the commitment.
Returned GameData memory struct assembled from the games and playerHashes mappings.
uint232 accumulator holding the packed status and player2 address.
Memory GameData snapshot loaded in cancelGame to drive refund branching.

edges.reason: constructor assigns msg.sender to the immutable OWNER_ADDRESS.
msg.sender is packed as player1 in the game id and stored via playerHashes.
msg.sender is encoded as player2 through encodeGameData.
houseJoinGame is guarded by require(msg.sender == OWNER_ADDRESS).
reveal branches on msg.sender matching g.p1 or g.p2 and reverts otherwise.
houseReveal is guarded by require(msg.sender == OWNER_ADDRESS).
getHash commits the caller address into keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, N)).
cancelGame authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against g.p1 and g.p2.
destruct is guarded by require(msg.sender == OWNER_ADDRESS).
createGame calls encodeGameID(msg.sender, msg.value) to build the id.
createGame calls encodeGameData(1, address(0)) to store status 1.
createGame writes the new game record into the games mapping.
createGame stores the player1 commitment at playerHashes[id+1].
joinGame loads the current game state via getGameData(id, false).
joinGame calls encodeGameData(2, msg.sender) to advance the status.
joinGame overwrites the packed game record in games.
joinGame stores the player2 commitment at playerHashes[id+2].
houseJoinGame reads OWNER_ADDRESS to authorize the caller.
houseJoinGame loads game state via getGameData.
houseJoinGame calls encodeGameData(3, g.p2).
houseJoinGame updates the game status in games.
houseJoinGame stores the house commitment at playerHashes[id+3].
reveal loads game state through getGameData.
reveal recomputes the commitment with getHash(N).
reveal reads and deletes the player commitment in playerHashes.
reveal records N in verifiedNumbers[id+1] or verifiedNumbers[id+2].
reveal writes status 4 to games once both players have revealed.
houseReveal reads OWNER_ADDRESS for the authorization check and the fee transfer.
houseReveal loads game state via getGameData.
houseReveal verifies the house hash using getHash(N).
houseReveal reads the house commitment from playerHashes[id+3].
houseReveal reads and clears verifiedNumbers when deriving ran.
houseReveal deletes the game record before paying out.
houseReveal transfers the payout to the caller-influenced winning address g.p1.
houseReveal transfers the house fee after computing it from the wager.
encodeGameID packs the wager with an unchecked shift that can truncate and collide ids.
player1 is cast to uint160 and placed in the low bits of the game id.
wager is divided by 1e17 and left-shifted into the upper bits of the uint176 id.
getGameData decodes the id into player1 and wager via decodeGameID.
getGameData decodes the packed word via decodeGameData.
getGameData reads the packed record from games and reverts on a missing game.
getGameData optionally reads playerHashes[id+1] and playerHashes[id+2].
getHash mixes msg.sender into the produced commitment.
cancelGame reads OWNER_ADDRESS to pay the 0.01 ether cancellation fee.
cancelGame loads game state through getGameData.
cancelGame deletes the record from games.
cancelGame deletes the stored commitments from playerHashes.
cancelGame deletes verifiedNumbers entries when status >= 3.
cancelGame transfers the cancellation fee to the owner after deleting state.
cancelGame refunds player1 with an external transfer.
cancelGame refunds player2 with an external transfer.
cancelGame refunds the sole player when the game status is 1.
destruct reads OWNER_ADDRESS both for the guard and as the payout target.
destruct executes selfdestruct to the owner address, permanently destroying the contract.
createGame uses its hash parameter as the player1 commitment.
joinGame uses the id parameter to locate the game record.
joinGame uses its hash parameter as the player2 commitment.
houseJoinGame uses the id parameter to locate the game.
houseJoinGame uses its hash parameter as the house commitment.
reveal uses the id parameter to load the game record.
reveal uses N in getHash and stores it as the verified number.
houseReveal uses the id parameter to load the game record.
houseReveal uses N both for hash verification and for deriving ran.
decodeGameID decodes the supplied encoded id.
encodeGameData places the status in the low 16 bits.
encodeGameData shifts player2 above the status field.
decodeGameData unpacks the supplied encoded word.
getGameData uses the id parameter to look up the game.
getGameData uses needHash to decide whether to expose commitments.
getHash concatenates N with msg.sender before hashing.
cancelGame uses the id parameter to load and delete the game record.
createGame receives the packed id returned by encodeGameID.
joinGame binds the loaded GameData struct to a memory local.
houseJoinGame binds the loaded GameData struct to a memory local.
reveal binds the loaded GameData struct to a memory local.
houseReveal binds the loaded GameData struct to a memory local.
houseReveal reads the stored house commitment into providedHash.
houseReveal computes realHash from getHash(N) for the comparison.
houseReveal derives the pseudo-random value ran from the verified numbers.
houseReveal computes payout = g.wager * 2 minus the fee.
houseReveal computes fee = payout * 3 / 100.
reveal reads the caller commitment into providedHash.
reveal computes realHash via getHash(N) for the commitment check.
getGameData assembles and returns the GameData memory struct g.
encodeGameData builds the packed uint232 accumulator encoded.
cancelGame binds the loaded GameData struct to a memory local.

normalization_plan.reason: Commitment parameter is only consumed by createGame and should be collapsed into that core function node.
Game identifier parameter is only consumed by joinGame and has no standalone semantic meaning.
Player2 commitment parameter flows only into joinGame state writes.
Identifier parameter is only used by houseJoinGame.
House commitment parameter is only used by houseJoinGame.
Identifier parameter is only consumed by reveal.
Revealed number is only used inside reveal for hash verification.
Identifier parameter is only consumed by houseReveal.
House number parameter is only used inside houseReveal randomness derivation.
Packing input only exists within the encodeGameID helper.
Wager packing input participates in the unchecked shift and belongs to encodeGameID.
Decoding input is only meaningful inside decodeGameID.
Status packing input is only used by encodeGameData.
Address packing input is only used by encodeGameData.
Decoding input is only meaningful inside decodeGameData.
Lookup parameter is only used by the getGameData view assembler.
Boolean flag only controls the getGameData return payload.
Nonce parameter is only consumed by getHash.
Identifier parameter is only consumed by cancelGame.
Return local for the encoded game id belongs to createGame.
Temporary GameData snapshot is scoped to joinGame.
Temporary GameData snapshot is scoped to houseJoinGame.
Temporary GameData snapshot is scoped to reveal.
Temporary GameData snapshot is scoped to houseReveal.
Hash comparison local is only used inside houseReveal.
Recomputed hash local is only used inside houseReveal.
Randomness local directly feeds the payout branch in houseReveal.
Payout amount is computed solely to be sent by payable(g.p1).transfer(payout).
Fee amount is computed solely to be sent by payable(OWNER_ADDRESS).transfer(fee).
Commitment local is only used inside reveal.
Recomputed hash local is only used inside reveal.
Returned struct local is only used inside getGameData.
Packing accumulator local is only used inside encodeGameData.
GameData snapshot local is only used to drive the refund branches of cancelGame.
